text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"One day, after the busy days had settled 
down, Sakura Laurel paid a visit to my 
room."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the promised day has arrived! Are 
you ready?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Off to the hot springs♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Hot Springs Trip Voucher" won in the 
shopping district raffle back around New 
Year's. Getting to the resort requires 
transferring between multiple trains.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's gotten quite warm, hasn't it? Maybe 
we won't even need jackets soon?
choice_data_list:
Let's grab a cold drink. What would you 
like?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, are you sure? Then... hmm, green tea 
please♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"First, let's buy a drink for Sakura 
Laurel. Pressing the vending machine 
button..."

text_block_list.name: Vending Machine Voice
text_block_list.text:
"7777! Congratulations! You win another 
one!"
choice_data_list: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you can actually win on that 
roulette! You're so lucky, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's rare for me to have good luck like 
this. Grabbing the drink that dropped from 
the vending machine, I boarded the train.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...! Trainer-san, look! Over there, see?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know things like this could 
happen. A rainbow, even though it hasn't 
rained...

text_block_list.name: Innkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Congra~~tulations~! You are our facility's 
100,000th guests!

text_block_list.name: Innkeeper
text_block_list.text:
In addition to what you've reserved, we'll 
be providing extra complimentary services 
today!
choice_data_list: Whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
A-A-Amazing! Incredible! What a streak of 
good luck, Trainer!
choice_data_list: If anything, it's scary how...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A stroke of luck like this doesn't happen 
very often. Wondering what was going on, I 
felt a mix of joy and unease when...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm not scared, not scared at all♪ Today 
was just one of those days.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here, why don't we take full 
advantage of the services and indulge in 
the utmost luxury? Letting our bodies 
slowly and deeply unwind.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If things keep going this well, I'm sure 
the hot springs will be wonderful too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... The view from the open-air bath 
was top-notch too... A solid three 
stars...♪
choice_data_list: This really is a great inn...
This really is a lovely inn...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Setting aside my momentary worries, the 
hot springs, the food, and everything else 
were a perfect ten out of ten.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Shall we get going soon, then? To that 
classic hot spring thing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, they're doing acupuncture and 
massage in the room next door."
choice_data_list:
If I recall, you said you're open to 
trying massages, right?

If I recall, you said you're open to 
trying massages, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ Actually, I spoke to the attendant 
earlier and made a reservation under both 
our names—

text_block_list.name: Familiar Acupuncturist
text_block_list.text: Oh my~!! Welco—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Screeech, slam!)
choice_data_list: ...Are you sure this is the right room?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! Even the confirmation slip I got 
when booking said it was this room, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Since this is such a top-tier facility, I 
don't think they'd hire anyone suspicious, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Familiar Acupuncturist
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, you shut the sliding door so 
suddenly, it startled me!

text_block_list.name: Familiar Acupuncturist
text_block_list.text:
But as a special treat, I'll forgive 
y-o-u!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Screeech, slam!)
choice_data_list:
(I really have a bad feeling about 
this...!)

text_block_list.name: Familiar Acupuncturist
text_block_list.text:
"Now, now, now, now~! Even a saint runs 
out of patience after three strikes! Come 
on, up onto the exam table you go~♪"
choice_data_list: Whoa, you got me!?
Wh-what, I got caught?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Familiar Acupuncturist
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what'll be on your menu? A 
pressure point for health and vigor? Or 
maybe a boost in charm?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer-san, how about I get the 
treatment first instead?

text_block_list.name: Familiar Acupuncturist
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so~? Well then, lie face down 
on the next table.
choice_data_list: No, please let me go first!!
No, please let me go first!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing wrong with the facility 
itself, but the acupuncturist's appearance 
makes me undeniably uneasy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's safe or not. Until I know for 
sure, I don't want anyone laying a single 
finger on Sakura Laurel. Steeling my 
resolve here—

text_block_list.name: Familiar Acupuncturist
text_block_list.text:
Now, relax your muscles~... And 
jab-a-roo!!
choice_data_list: Urk...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Trainer?! You just groaned, didn't you...?
choice_data_list:
It doesn't hurt...! My body feels so much 
better!

It doesn't hurt...! My body feels so 
light!

text_block_list.name: Acupuncturist
text_block_list.text:
I am so terribly sorry! Thank you for 
waiting! For Sakura Laurel-sama, who made 
the reservation, and—

text_block_list.name: Acupuncturist
text_block_list.text:
...Who are you? You're not part of our 
staff, are you...?
choice_data_list: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Familiar Acupuncturist
text_block_list.text: Kyaha~~!

text_block_list.name: Acupuncturist
text_block_list.text: H-Hey! W-Wait up~!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Umm...
choice_data_list:
...Let's have a proper professional treat 
you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: That's true... Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The facility staff apologized profusely, 
and Sakura Laurel was safely treated to a 
massage by a properly verified member of 
the staff.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...We did run into a rather eccentric 
person, but it turned out lucky in the 
end. It looks like your body loosened up 
nicely too, Trainer.
choice_data_list: It was a blessing in disguise.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu. "Fortunate," you say?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. Do you remember what 
happened shortly before we formed our 
team?
choice_data_list: Umm...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first time I offered Sakura Laurel a 
contract was during her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I listened to her dream and told her, 
"I want to make your dream come true 
together," Sakura Laurel told me to hold 
on for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Even if those feelings are real, it's 
quite far off... Could you wait until a 
distant season?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then spring arrived, I met her once 
again, ...and began pursuing our dream.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I thought that if I waited a 
little longer, my legs might get into 
better shape.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I made you wait. ...Yet my 
legs remain unchanged."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Combined with the fact that I had already 
entered my prime, I grew terribly anxious. 
I started to wonder if I might even miss 
my chance to debut."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, even before the 
Classic period, right from the debut 
stage, I might have been rushing things."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I've had brief moments where I 
thought about it. Wondering why I ended up 
as an Umamusume who's so 'unblessed.'"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —Still, I managed to find happiness.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Having been able to run alongside you, I 
was able to taste such magnificent 
happiness."
choice_data_list: ...I'm really happy too.
...I'm really happy too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "On n'a qu'une vie." —You only live once.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad that you were my partner for 
that one time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between Sakura Laurel 
and myself...
